_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 45895b5f — ConceptCreationService writes the RETIRED `ims__` namespace. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute). The negative half of each axis is what these mutants exist for: an axis asserting only the presence of the new key stays green when the OLD key is written alongside it. M2 is the one the ticket calls out explicitly — `concept__Concept_broader` is an `exo__DeprecatedProperty` (useInstead → `concept__Concept_genus`, 06d389ff), so writing it would satisfy a naive «is a concept__ key present» assertion while still being wrong. `red_re` anchors on the `● <suite> › <title>` failure header, NOT on the bare `[Cn]` key: jest echoes the SOURCE LINE of a neighbouring `it(...)` in its diff context, so a key-only pattern reports a green axis as red (integration-test-revert-verify §A44/§A104).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/ConceptCreationService.ts

M1_writes_retired_ims_genus_key._note: Restores the retired `ims__Concept_broader` key (the pre-fix state). MEASURED red set is [C1,C3], not the predicted [C1] alone: C3 asserts the ABSENCE of the substring `ims__Concept`, and `ims__Concept_broader` contains it as a PREFIX. That is a property of the assertion, not a leak between axes — C3's job is precisely to reject the retired namespace in any form, so it fires on every ims__ key the service could write. Written from the measurement (§A97).

M2_writes_DEPRECATED_broader_instead_of_._note: Writes `concept__Concept_broader` — the LIVE namespace but a DEPRECATED property. This is the tempting wrong fix, and an axis that only checks for a `concept__` key would stay green. Predicted: C1. MEASURED [C1] alone — and that is the point of this mutant: `concept__Concept_broader` does NOT contain the `ims__Concept` substring, so C3 stays green and C1 is the ONLY axis standing between this wrong fix and a green suite. Had C1 lacked its negative half, this mutant would have shipped undetected.

M3_writes_retired_ims_definition_key._note: Restores the retired `ims__Concept_definition` key. MEASURED [C2,C3] for the same substring reason as M1 — `ims__Concept_definition` carries the `ims__Concept` prefix C3 rejects. Written from the measurement (§A97).

M4_asset_typed_as_something_else._note: Added 2026-09-25 after post-factum review of PR #4351 showed C3 could not fail for this. Retypes the created asset as a DIFFERENT class while every concept__ KEY stays in place. Before C3 was anchored on the emitted list item, the whole suite stayed green here: `toContain("concept__Concept")` had three witnesses (the class value plus the keys concept__Concept_genus / concept__Concept_definition), so removing one of them changed nothing (integration-test-revert-verify §A33). The defect this ticket exists to prevent — an asset that no class resolver and no SHACL shape will pick up — was therefore invisible to its own axes. Predicted [C3]; the measured set is what the `expect` below records.
